items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: And Joe Robichaux and I, I was playing banjo then. And we played at a little place down on Charter Street.

ctx.x: Yeah, maybe heard the name, but I don't know anything about him. Freddie Babu. Yeah. I played some bandages, somebody might have mentioned that.
And Joe Robichaux and I, I was playing banjo then. And we played at a little place down on Charter Street. It was only for a short while. We played there on...
Well, where on Charter? There's nothing here.
